fieldValues.title: RFC-009 Change D: Define containers_for_instance as a normative core operation
fieldValues.proposed_change: containers_for_instance(instanceId: UUID) -> Container[]: returns every Container whose effective(C) contains the instance, where membership is the instanceId values of the entries in memberInstanceIds read flat (RFC-043 [R3], [R18]). All conforming implementations MUST provide this operation (I-66). Core operation, not extension-gated.
fieldValues.rationale: The three inclusion conditions are all core Container and Relation concepts. Gating behind an extension would leave implementations without a reliable root-record to container reverse lookup. Core entities need core operations.
